subject: Skill Labs — starter trial pool for instructor mini-workshops

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@skill-labs.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: starter promo pool for Skill Labs instructor mini-workshops

Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re well — I run partnerships at Skill Labs. We’re running a three-week mini-workshop series targeted at developer bootcamp grads (Aug 31–Sep 14) and expect ~300 registrants across six sessions. Can Redwood provide a starter pool of promo/trial codes we can hand out to registrants (preferably single-use, 3-month trials)?

What we’d need: 1) Quantity: 75 codes to start, 2) Expiration: 90 days, 3) Billing: should we be invoiced or charged to a marketing budget? We’re a PR/partner marketing partner so want clear attribution in HubSpot.

Attaching a brief SOW and our partner terms for reference. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Alyssa Park
Partnerships — Skill Labs
alyssa@skill-labs.io
Attachments: SOW_SkillLabs.pdf

Folks — forwarding a partner ask from Skill Labs. Key points: they want a 75-code starter pool, single-use, 90-day trials, and HubSpot attribution. SOW attached.

My take: approve a smaller initial batch (50) and increase if uptake looks strong. We should tag codes with partner=SkillLabs and campaign=miniworkshops_Aug26. Karthik — can you confirm billing center and whether we want standard 3-month trial or a trimmed 1-month to limit cost? Marissa — ops will need to provision codes and provide a link/CSV they can distribute.

Proposed next steps: 1) Karthik signs off on quantity and billing, 2) Marissa provisions codes and sets promo metadata, 3) we send final SOW/DocuSign if they need invoicing.

Thanks,
Sofia
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

Sofia — thanks for the ping. I’m OK with sponsoring this, but recommend we start with 60 single-use codes (not 50) to avoid shortfalls; if redemption rates are low we can reclaim the remainder. Charge to MKT-Q3 (campaign code MKT-Q3-PART) and tag HubSpot company ID 98765 for attribution.

Trial length: I’m comfortable with the full 90-day trial for partners on partner-sourced leads for now. Please add a note to the SOW that codes are single-use and non-transferable.

Marissa — can ops create a code batch with these properties and include the partner=SkillLabs and campaign=miniworkshops_Aug26 tags in the metadata? Also please create a short landing snippet we can share with registrants (one-liner + redemption link).

Karthik
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

- Codes: 60 single-use, expire 2026-11-18 (90 days)
- Metadata: partner=SkillLabs, campaign=miniworkshops_Aug26, hubspot_company_id=98765
- Landing copy: "Redeem your Skill Labs trial at redwood.com/redeem — valid for 90 days from activation."
- Billing: tag to MKT-Q3-PART as requested; ops will send an internal charge memo to finance.

Alyssa — can you confirm whether you want codes delivered as a single CSV link or split into 6 batches (one per session)? We can do either; batches make it easier to reconcile per-session uptake. Also please sign the attached SOW (I’ve added a one-line clause about single-use codes) — we can DocuSign if you prefer.

I’ve attached the partner promo terms for legal. Follow-up items: HubSpot campaign created here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/campaigns/miniworkshops_Aug26 and I’ll upload the CSV to the Drive folder linked in the thread.
